grounds.heading: ODD/11. Core law/11.7A Conforming agentic development
ODD/11. Core law/11.7A Conforming agentic development

semantic.statement: Agents work from the smallest sufficient declared packet with source refs, not stale memory or wholesale hidden context. Compression is prompt input, never deciding authority; generic derived frames may orient precedence/re-entry/traceability but product behavior must come from current Product authority. A passed admission and completed walkthrough are conformance evidence, not ratification; repeated use cannot amend shared method or constitutionalize grey work.
